control_image.description: Image to use with control net
control_image.title: Control Image

control_strength.description: Strength of control net. Different controls work better with different strengths. Canny works best with 0.5, soft edge works best with 0.4, and depth works best between 0.5 and 0.75. If images are low quality, try reducing the strength and try reducing the guidance scale.
control_strength.title: Control Strength

depth_preprocessor.description: Preprocessor to use with depth control net
depth_preprocessor.title: Depth Preprocessor

image_to_image_strength.description: Strength of image to image control. 0 means none of the control image is used. 1 means the control image is returned used as is. Try values between 0 and 0.25 for best results.
image_to_image_strength.title: Image To Image Strength

lora_url.description: Optional LoRA model to use. Give a URL to a HuggingFace .safetensors file, a Replicate .tar file or a CivitAI download link.
lora_url.title: Lora Url

negative_prompt.description: Things you do not want to see in your image
negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt

output_quality.description: Quality of the output images, from 0 to 100. 100 is best quality, 0 is lowest quality.
output_quality.title: Output Quality

return_preprocessed_image.description: Return the preprocessed image used to control the generation process. Useful for debugging.
return_preprocessed_image.title: Return Preprocessed Image

seed.description: Seed value for random number generator. Uncheck for reproducible results.
seed.title: Seed

soft_edge_preprocessor.description: Preprocessor to use with soft edge control net
soft_edge_preprocessor.title: Soft Edge Preprocessor
